theorems.name: Submission.rsd_cmr_isIntegerMultiplicity_of_const_mult
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U V : Set (Euclid P)) (hVU : V ⊆ U) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (T₀ : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (N₀ : ℕ), IsOpen V → 0 < N₀ → R.Represents T → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ V → R.mult x = N₀) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, T (testFormOnInclusion hVU n ω) = (N₀ : ℝ) * T₀ ω) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₀
